title: Duterte’s ICC trial: Prosecutors seek protection for 55 witnesses
summary: Prosecutors at the International Criminal Court (ICC) have formally requested special in-court protective measures for 55 witnesses ahead of the upcoming trial of former president Rodrigo Duterte.
